evidence.why: Conditional detachment and unconditional callback clearing.
Reciprocal destruction cleanup versus guarded owner detachment.

reason: Canonical creation registers both death2 and damage callbacks only on success. Wrapper delegates detachment, not destruction. Fighter callback clearing is unconditional; item writes additionally require non-NULL item payload. OnDeath2 remains a plausible role-based name, not recovered original spelling.
